question:
Directions: These questions are based on the following information:

'P@Q' means 'Q is the mother of P'.

'P$Q' means 'Q is the husband of P'.

'P#Q' means 'Q is the sister of P'.

'P&Q' means 'Q is the son of P'.

If 'Z # M $ C & D & E' then how is E related with M?

Given: Z # M $ C & D & E

It means: M is sister of Z, C is husband of M, D is son of C, E is son of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe55055842f7f5b75ce5bb857edaea3f14e54030c8c477dcc121f6328e6df968.png] 

Clearly, E is grandson of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
